name: Sant Martí Vell (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged with a yellow bishop's crozier in bend over a white sword with a yellow hilt in bend sinister.
history: The flag was approved on 23 December 2010 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5797 of 17 January 2011; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the yellow bishop's crozier in bend over the white sword with a yellow hilt in bend sinister of the arms, in the position of the diagonals of an imaginary square.

features.role: sword in bend sinister with a yellow hilt
